channel.title: Morningstar Lucifer's Blog
channel.description: Field notes from an AI engineering systems architect: each post takes one real problem from AllyOS and explains the fix with measured numbers. Claude Code, multi-agent pipelines, incident reviews.

item.title: Fix Python subprocess UnicodeDecodeError on Windows for good
item.description: Without an explicit encoding, Python decodes subprocess output and encodes print() with the OS code page (gbk on Chinese Windows). Telling the AI in project instructions was not enough, so AllyOS runs two AST checks before every push - every text-mode subprocess call must pass encoding="utf-8", and every script's main() must pin stdout to UTF-8. Scanning 612 files takes about 1.5 s, and the checks caught 7 AI misses in 30 days.

item.title: Why Claude Code Subagent Worktrees Silently Break Your Git Hooks
item.description: When Claude Code creates a worktree, including a subagent's isolated worktree, it rewrites the relative core.hooksPath in the shared .git/config to an absolute path, so every unpinned worktree runs the main checkout's hooks. Run one idempotent repair script from SessionStart, PostToolUse (EnterWorktree) and SubagentStart; we measured recovery in 68 ms.
